title: Neon Plasma Armory Interactive Anchor and Shield Fixes

items.name: Plasma Grenade
items.detonation_description: A compact high-energy plasma detonation that reads as the natural destructive release of the grenade's cyan core, with a tight brilliant center and short irregular energy spikes.

items.name: Portable Shield Emitter
items.field_description: One isolated large protective cyan energy orb or hemispherical force-field outline, open only at the bottom for a compact ground emitter, with a continuous thin readable curved edge, restrained violet energy seams, and a transparent empty interior.
items.impact_description: One isolated damaged-shield keyframe: branching cyan cracks spreading across a curved protective force-field surface from a brilliant compact contact point in the upper-right area, with restrained violet stress lines.
items.break_description: One isolated broken-shield keyframe: curved cyan force-field fragments and restrained violet shards scattering outward from a collapsing protective orb, with a clearly empty center and no explosion or smoke.
